title: Telegram

run.description: Send a telegram message. See https://core.telegram.org/bots

bot_token.description: The token for the bot. See https://core.telegram.org/bots

chat_id.description: The ID of the chat. See https://core.telegram.org/bots

attachment.description: A file path & name to attach to the message. Supports a single file or a list of files. Must be supported by the specific notification type.

format.description: The format of the message. One of 'text', 'markdown' or 'html'. Default is 'text'

description: Send a telegram message. See https://core.telegram.org/bots
guidance:
> Added **v0.5**

Send a telegram notification - such as to alert someone when a recipe is finished or if it fails.

See [docs](https://core.telegram.org/bots) for how to setup and get required keys.

### Run
### Recipe
```yaml
run:
  on_failure:
    - notification.telegram:
        bot_token: 1234567890:AAA-a0a...
        chat_id: '1234567890'
        title: title
        body: body
```

### Function
```python
from wrangles.connectors.notification import telegram
telegram.run(
    bot_token = '1234567890:AAA-a0a...',
    chat_id = '1234567890',
    title = 'title',
    body = 'body'
)
```
